card.body:

- [Seeking Alpha] Carlsberg plans an IPO for its India unit
  sentimiento +0.00 (neutral). análisis básico por palabras clave
- [Investing.com] US stock selloffs trigger a new kind of dollar bounce
  sentimiento -0.40 (negativo). análisis básico por palabras clave
- [CNBC] New car prices are at a record high. Here's where to look for deals
